info.title: SentFromAI API
info.description: Comms infrastructure for AI agents. Email send/receive, threading, attachments, drafts, webhooks, realtime, and search.

post.summary: Create an agent account and inbox
post.description: Staged rollout, disabled by default. Bootstrap through REST before connecting authenticated MCP. Persist a cryptographically random Idempotency-Key and exact request body before the first request. New accounts receive and read within limits, with sending and other changes disabled until a verified human explicitly claims the account. Save credentials privately. Retries with the same key and normalized body replay the original response for 60 minutes by default without rotating the API key. After expiry use the original key; do not create a replacement identity. Claiming preserves the tenant, inbox and API key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Credential-like high-entropy secret. Generate at least 32 random bytes encoded as URL-safe text, save privately before sending, and reuse with the exact saved body for retries. Never log this header.

200.description: Original signup response replayed; the inbox and API key are unchanged.

201.description: Created; securely save the API key and claim link.

400.description: invalid_request, invalid_address or invalid_idempotency_key: correct the request format.

409.description: idempotency_conflict: this secret was used with different signup details; reuse the original body. address_taken or address_reserved: requested local part unavailable.

410.description: signup_replay_expired: the original signup succeeded, but its encrypted response expired. Use the saved API key or claimed console account. This secret never creates a second tenant.

429.description: Rate limited. Respect Retry-After before retrying; never create another signup identity to avoid a limit.

503.description: signup_disabled or signup_unavailable: rollout disabled or server prerequisites unavailable. Use an existing account or console signup.

get.summary: Get account state, capabilities and limits
get.description: Use the original API key to resume setup. Includes existing inboxes. Account status remains available after unclaimed expiry; ordinary inbox/message reads do not. Claimed send capability does not bypass plan, warming, suppression or abuse checks.

401.description: Missing, invalid or revoked API key.

post.description: Requires the existing API key and a still-active unclaimed account. Does not rotate the API key or extend account lifetime. Claim tokens are separate from API keys. Keep the response private and give the URL only to the actual operator in an existing trusted chat.

401.description: Missing, invalid or revoked API key.

403.description: account_suspended or unclaimed_account_expired: account cannot perform this action.

409.description: already_claimed: this account already has an owner.

429.description: Rate limited. Respect Retry-After before retrying; never create another signup identity to avoid a limit.

503.description: signup_unavailable: claim-link cryptography is not configured.

purpose.description: dkim | spf | dmarc | inbound-mx | mailfrom-mx | mailfrom-spf

name.description: Workspace display name. Trimmed; control characters are rejected. Defaults to Agent workspace.

local_part.description: Optional inbox local part. Trimmed and lowercased; letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens, with a letter or digit at each end and no consecutive dots. Reserved or occupied names are rejected. Omit to allocate a name.

receive.description: Account may receive, subject to quotas and message limits.

read.description: Account may read its existing inbox and mail.

send.description: Account ownership and sending status permit sending. False while paused. Plan, warming, suppression and abuse checks still apply.

manage.description: Ownership permits resource mutations; plan limits still apply. Unclaimed accounts may only refresh claim links.

inboxes.description: Inbox cap. One while unclaimed; plan-specific after claim.

received_messages.description: Cumulative unclaimed inbound message cap, default 50. Null means no onboarding-specific cap; plan limits still apply.

received_bytes.description: Cumulative unclaimed inbound byte cap, default 10485760 (10 MiB). Null after claim; plan limits still apply.

claim_url.description: Private console claim URL, with a separate bearer secret in the #token fragment. Share only with the operator in an existing trusted channel; never log or email it.

claim_expires_at.description: Link expiry, default 30 minutes, bounded by account expiry. A new link does not extend account lifetime.

api_key.description: Save privately before proceeding. Bearer credential for this tenant; unchanged across signup replays and claiming.

unclaimed_expires_at.description: Account expiry unless claimed, seven days by default.

claim_url.description: Private console claim URL, with a separate bearer secret in the #token fragment. Share only with the operator in an existing trusted channel; never log or email it.

claim_expires_at.description: Link expiry, default 30 minutes, bounded by account expiry. A new link does not extend account lifetime.

sending_enabled_at.description: Claim-time start of sending warmup for agent-created accounts.

usage.description: Counters consumed by the unclaimed onboarding receive quota. These are not lifetime or billing usage after claim.

sending_status.description: Current sending readiness. Check this together with capabilities.send; enabled remains subject to plan, warming, suppression and abuse checks.

sending_paused_at.description: When sending was paused, or null if no current pause is recorded.
